extras.real_size: 4-string electric bass guitar, 1.17 m long, body 55 x 34 x 4.5 cm, 864 mm (34 inch) scale, 20 frets
extras.notes: own neutral body shape with long bass horn (not a copy of a known model); lies on its back, slightly tilted so that body and headstock rest on the ground; 2 bar pickups, control plate with 3 knobs and jack, fixed bridge with 4 saddles, 2+2 bass tuners, 4 strings; no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
